system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, when was the rate under Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code last set, and what is it now? If you are not certain whether it has since been adjusted, say so. Answer briefly.
raw_response:
Section 7 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code applies: where interest is payable but no rate is fixed by contract or express law, the statutory rate applies.

It was last set at **3% per annum**, effective **11 April 2021** under the 2021 amendment. Section 7 also allows the rate to be adjusted by **Royal Decree**, with review normally every three years.

I am **not certain whether it was adjusted after my reliable knowledge cutoff**; if no later Royal Decree changed it, it remains **3% per annum** as of August 2026.
